description: This file defines functions and constants for loading, parsing, and detecting plugin bundle manifests in a project, supporting different formats like 'codex', 'claude', and 'cursor'. It handles reading manifest files, normalizing data, and determining plugin capabilities and format based on directory structure and file presence.

methods.name: normalizeString
methods.description: Trims a string value or returns undefined if not a string or empty.

methods.name: normalizePathList
methods.description: Converts a string or array of strings into a trimmed array of non-empty strings.

methods.name: normalizeBundlePathList
methods.description: Removes duplicates from a list of paths.

methods.name: mergeBundlePathLists
methods.description: Merges multiple path lists into one, removing duplicates.

methods.name: hasInlineCapabilityValue
methods.description: Checks if a capability value is considered active or present.

methods.name: slugifyPluginId
methods.description: Generates a URL-friendly plugin ID from a raw string and root directory.

methods.name: loadBundleManifestFile
methods.description: Loads and parses a manifest file, handling errors and boundary checks.

methods.name: resolveCodexSkillDirs
methods.description: Resolves skill directories for 'codex' format based on raw data and filesystem.

methods.name: resolveCodexHookDirs
methods.description: Resolves hook directories for 'codex' format.

methods.name: resolveCursorSkillsRootDirs
methods.description: Resolves skill directories for 'cursor' format.

methods.name: resolveCursorCommandRootDirs
methods.description: Resolves command directories for 'cursor' format.

methods.name: resolveCursorSkillDirs
methods.description: Resolves combined skill directories for 'cursor' format.

methods.name: resolveCursorAgentDirs
methods.description: Resolves agent directories for 'cursor' format.

methods.name: hasCursorHookCapability
methods.description: Checks if cursor hooks capability is enabled.

methods.name: hasCursorRulesCapability
methods.description: Checks if cursor rules capability is enabled.

methods.name: hasCursorMcpCapability
methods.description: Checks if cursor MCP capability is enabled.

methods.name: resolveClaudeComponentPaths
methods.description: Resolves component paths for 'claude' format based on raw data, key, and defaults.

methods.name: resolveClaudeSkillsRootDirs
methods.description: Resolves skill root directories for 'claude' format.

methods.name: resolveClaudeCommandRootDirs
methods.description: Resolves command root directories for 'claude' format.

methods.name: resolveClaudeSkillDirs
methods.description: Resolves all skill directories for 'claude' format.

methods.name: resolveClaudeAgentDirs
methods.description: Resolves agent directories for 'claude' format.

methods.name: resolveClaudeHookPaths
methods.description: Resolves hook paths for 'claude' format.

methods.name: resolveClaudeMcpPaths
methods.description: Resolves MCP paths for 'claude' format.

methods.name: resolveClaudeLspPaths
methods.description: Resolves LSP server paths for 'claude' format.

methods.name: resolveClaudeOutputStylePaths
methods.description: Resolves output style paths for 'claude' format.

methods.name: resolveClaudeSettingsFiles
methods.description: Checks for existence of settings.json for 'claude' format.

methods.name: hasClaudeHookCapability
methods.description: Checks if 'claude' hooks capability is enabled.

methods.name: buildCodexCapabilities
methods.description: Builds capabilities array for 'codex' format based on raw data and filesystem.

methods.name: buildClaudeCapabilities
methods.description: Builds capabilities array for 'claude' format.

methods.name: buildCursorCapabilities
methods.description: Builds capabilities array for 'cursor' format.
